#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

struct node {
    int diff;
    int indx;
};

bool compareNodes(const node& a, const node& b) {
    if (a.diff - b.diff != 0)
        return a.diff - b.diff < 0;
    else
        return a.indx - b.indx < 0;
}

int main() {
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> oddEven(n);
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
        if (i == 0) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                oddEven[i] = 1;
            } else
                oddEven[i] = -1;
            continue;
        }
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] + 1;
        } else
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] - 1;
    }
    vector<node> diffArr(n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        diffArr[i].diff = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
        diffArr[i].indx = i;
    }
    sort(diffArr.begin(), diffArr.end(), compareNodes);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (k >= diffArr[i].diff && oddEven[diffArr[i].indx] == 0) {
            if (k - diffArr[i].diff >= 0) {
                ans++;
                k = k - diffArr[i].diff;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
